AC-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] access control policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and the associated access controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the access control policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current access control:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

AC-11.enunciado:
a. Prevent further access to the system by [Selección (una o más): initiating a device lock after {{ insert: param, ac-11_odp.02 }} of inactivity; requiring the user to initiate a device lock before leaving the system unattended]; and
b. Retain the device lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

AC-17.enunciado:
a. Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and
b. Authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

AC-17(1).enunciado: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.

AC-18.enunciado:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and
b. Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

AC-19.enunciado:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for organization-controlled mobile devices, to include when such devices are outside of controlled areas; and
b. Authorize the connection of mobile devices to organizational systems.

AC-2(12).enunciado:
(a) Monitor system accounts for [Asignación: atypical usage]; and
(b) Report atypical usage of system accounts to [Asignación: personnel or roles].

AC-20.enunciado:
a. [Selección (una o más): establish {{ insert: param, ac-20_odp.02 }}; identify {{ insert: param, ac-20_odp.03 }}], consistent with the trust relationships established with other organizations owning, operating, and/or maintaining external systems, allowing authorized individuals to:
  1. Access the system from external systems; and
  2. Process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information using external systems; or
b. Prohibit the use of [Asignación: prohibited types of external systems].

AC-24.enunciado: [Selección (una o más): establish procedures; implement mechanisms] to ensure [Asignación: access control decisions] are applied to each access request prior to access enforcement.

AC-3.enunciado: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

AC-3(11).titulo: Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
AC-3(11).enunciado: Restrict access to data repositories containing [Asignación: information types].

AC-4.enunciado: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on [Asignación: information flow control policies].

AC-4(23).enunciado: When transferring information between different security domains, modify non-releasable information by implementing [Asignación: modification action].

AC-4(25).enunciado: When transferring information between different security domains, sanitize data to minimize [Selección (una o más): delivery of malicious content, command and control of malicious code, malicious code augmentation, and steganography-encoded data; spillage of sensitive information] in accordance with [Asignación: policy].

AC-5.enunciado:
a. Identify and document [Asignación: duties of individuals]; and
b. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

AC-6.enunciado: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

AC-7.enunciado:
a. Enforce a limit of [Asignación: number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Asignación: time period]; and
b. Automatically [Selección (una o más): lock the account or node for {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.04 }}; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.05 }}; notify system administrator; take other {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.06 }}] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

AC-7(2).enunciado: Purge or wipe information from [Asignación: mobile devices] based on [Asignación: purging or wiping requirements and techniques] after [Asignación: number] consecutive, unsuccessful device logon attempts.

AC-9.enunciado: Notify the user, upon successful logon to the system, of the date and time of the last logon.

AT-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] awareness and training policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the awareness and training policy and the associated awareness and training controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the awareness and training policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current awareness and training:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

AT-3.enunciado:
a. Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with the following roles and responsibilities: [Asignación: organization-defined roles and responsibilities]:
  1. Before authorizing access to the system, information, or performing assigned duties, and [Asignación: frequency] thereafter; and
  2. When required by system changes;
b. Update role-based training content [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
c. Incorporate lessons learned from internal or external security incidents or breaches into role-based training.

AU-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] audit and accountability policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the audit and accountability policy and the associated audit and accountability controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the audit and accountability policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current audit and accountability:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

AU-10(3).enunciado: Maintain reviewer or releaser credentials within the established chain of custody for information reviewed or released.

AU-11.enunciado: Retain audit records for [Asignación: time period] to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational information retention requirements.

AU-13.enunciado:
a. Monitor [Asignación: open-source information and/or information sites] [Asignación: frequency] for evidence of unauthorized disclosure of organizational information; and
b. If an information disclosure is discovered:
  1. Notify [Asignación: personnel or roles]; and
  2. Take the following additional actions: [Asignación: additional actions].

AU-14.enunciado:
a. Provide and implement the capability for [Asignación: users or roles] to [Selección (una o más): record; view; hear; log] the content of a user session under [Asignación: circumstances]; and
b. Develop, integrate, and use session auditing activities in consultation with legal counsel and in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines.

AU-4.enunciado: Allocate audit log storage capacity to accommodate [Asignación: audit log retention requirements].

AU-6.titulo: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

AU-6(6).enunciado: Correlate information from audit records with information obtained from monitoring physical access to further enhance the ability to identify suspicious, inappropriate, unusual, or malevolent activity.

AU-8.enunciado:
a. Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records; and
b. Record time stamps for audit records that meet [Asignación: granularity of time measurement] and that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or that include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

AU-9.enunciado:
a. Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion; and
b. Alert [Asignación: personnel or roles] upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information.

CA-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and the associated assessment, authorization, and monitoring controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current assessment, authorization, and monitoring:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

CA-2(1).enunciado: Employ independent assessors or assessment teams to conduct control assessments.

CM-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] configuration management policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the configuration management policy and the associated configuration management controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the configuration management policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current configuration management:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

CM-2.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control, a current baseline configuration of the system; and
b. Review and update the baseline configuration of the system:
  1. [Asignación: frequency];
  2. When required due to [Asignación: circumstances]; and
  3. When system components are installed or upgraded.

CM-2(3).enunciado: Retain [Asignación: number] of previous versions of baseline configurations of the system to support rollback.

CM-3(7).enunciado: Review changes to the system [Asignación: frequency] or when [Asignación: circumstances] to determine whether unauthorized changes have occurred.

CM-3(8).enunciado: Prevent or restrict changes to the configuration of the system under the following circumstances: [Asignación: circumstances].

CM-4.enunciado: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to change implementation.

CM-4(1).enunciado: Analyze changes to the system in a separate test environment before implementation in an operational environment, looking for security and privacy impacts due to flaws, weaknesses, incompatibility, or intentional malice.

CM-5.enunciado: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to the system.

CM-7.enunciado:
a. Configure the system to provide only [Asignación: mission-essential capabilities]; and
b. Prohibit or restrict the use of the following functions, ports, protocols, software, and/or services: [Asignación: organization-defined prohibited or restricted functions, system ports, protocols, software, and/or services].

CM-9(1).enunciado: Assign responsibility for developing the configuration management process to organizational personnel that are not directly involved in system development.

CP-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] contingency planning policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the contingency planning policy and the associated contingency planning controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the contingency planning policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current contingency planning:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

CP-10.enunciado: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within [Asignación: organization-defined time period consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives] after a disruption, compromise, or failure.

CP-11.enunciado: Provide the capability to employ [Asignación: alternative communications protocols] in support of maintaining continuity of operations.

CP-13.enunciado: Employ [Asignación: alternative or supplemental security mechanisms] for satisfying [Asignación: security functions] when the primary means of implementing the security function is unavailable or compromised.

CP-2(1).enunciado: Coordinate contingency plan development with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

CP-2(2).enunciado: Conduct capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications, and environmental support exists during contingency operations.

CP-2(8).enunciado: Identify critical system assets supporting [Selección (una): all; essential] mission and business functions.

CP-3.enunciado:
a. Provide contingency training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities:
  1. Within [Asignación: time period] of assuming a contingency role or responsibility;
  2. When required by system changes; and
  3. [Asignación: frequency] thereafter; and
b. Review and update contingency training content [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

CP-4.enunciado:
a. Test the contingency plan for the system [Asignación: frequency] using the following tests to determine the effectiveness of the plan and the readiness to execute the plan: [Asignación: organization-defined tests].
b. Review the contingency plan test results; and
c. Initiate corrective actions, if needed.

CP-4(1).enunciado: Coordinate contingency plan testing with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

CP-6.enunciado:
a. Establish an alternate storage site, including necessary agreements to permit the storage and retrieval of system backup information; and
b. Ensure that the alternate storage site provides controls equivalent to that of the primary site.

CP-8.enunciado: Establish alternate telecommunications services, including necessary agreements to permit the resumption of [Asignación: system operations] for essential mission and business functions within [Asignación: time period] when the primary telecommunications capabilities are unavailable at either the primary or alternate processing or storage sites.

IA-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] identification and authentication policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the identification and authentication policy and the associated identification and authentication controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the identification and authentication policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current identification and authentication:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

IA-2.enunciado: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

IA-6.enunciado: Obscure feedback of authentication information during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation and use by unauthorized individuals.

IA-8.enunciado: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

IR-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] incident response policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the incident response policy and the associated incident response controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the incident response policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current incident response:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

IR-2.enunciado:
a. Provide incident response training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities:
  1. Within [Asignación: time period] of assuming an incident response role or responsibility or acquiring system access;
  2. When required by system changes; and
  3. [Asignación: frequency] thereafter; and
b. Review and update incident response training content [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

IR-4(13).enunciado: Analyze anomalous or suspected adversarial behavior in or related to [Asignación: environments or resources].

IR-6.enunciado:
a. Require personnel to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within [Asignación: time period]; and
b. Report incident information to [Asignación: authorities].

MA-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] maintenance policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the maintenance policy and the associated maintenance controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the maintenance policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current maintenance:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

MA-4(1).enunciado:
(a) Log [Asignación: organization-defined audit events] for nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions; and
(b) Review the audit records of the maintenance and diagnostic sessions to detect anomalous behavior.

MA-4(3).enunciado:
(a) Require that nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic services be performed from a system that implements a security capability comparable to the capability implemented on the system being serviced; or
(b) Remove the component to be serviced from the system prior to nonlocal maintenance or diagnostic services; sanitize the component (for organizational information); and after the service is performed, inspect and sanitize the component (for potentially malicious software) before reconnecting the component to the system.

MA-6.enunciado: Obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for [Asignación: system components] within [Asignación: time period] of failure.

MP-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] media protection policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the media protection policy and the associated media protection controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the media protection policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current media protection:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

MP-2.enunciado: Restrict access to [Asignación: organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media] to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles].

MP-3.enunciado:
a. Mark system media indicating the distribution limitations, handling caveats, and applicable security markings (if any) of the information; and
b. Exempt [Asignación: types of media exempted from marking] from marking if the media remain within [Asignación: controlled areas].

MP-4.enunciado:
a. Physically control and securely store [Asignación: organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media] within [Asignación: organization-defined controlled areas]; and
b. Protect system media types defined in MP-4a until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques, and procedures.

MP-6.enunciado:
a. Sanitize [Asignación: organization-defined system media] prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse using [Asignación: organization-defined sanitization techniques and procedures]; and
b. Employ sanitization mechanisms with the strength and integrity commensurate with the security category or classification of the information.

MP-6(1).titulo: Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify
MP-6(1).enunciado: Review, approve, track, document, and verify media sanitization and disposal actions.

MP-7.enunciado:
a. [Selección (una): restrict; prohibit] the use of [Asignación: types of system media] on [Asignación: systems or system components] using [Asignación: controls]; and
b. Prohibit the use of portable storage devices in organizational systems when such devices have no identifiable owner.

PE-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] physical and environmental protection policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the physical and environmental protection policy and the associated physical and environmental protection controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the physical and environmental protection policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current physical and environmental protection:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

PE-11.enunciado: Provide an uninterruptible power supply to facilitate [Selección (una): an orderly shutdown of the system; transition of the system to long-term alternate power] in the event of a primary power source loss.

PE-12.enunciado: Employ and maintain automatic emergency lighting for the system that activates in the event of a power outage or disruption and that covers emergency exits and evacuation routes within the facility.

PE-13.enunciado: Employ and maintain fire detection and suppression systems that are supported by an independent energy source.

PE-14.enunciado:
a. Maintain [Selección (una o más): temperature; humidity; pressure; radiation; {{ insert: param, pe-14_odp.02 }}] levels within the facility where the system resides at [Asignación: acceptable levels]; and
b. Monitor environmental control levels [Asignación: frequency].

PE-15.enunciado: Protect the system from damage resulting from water leakage by providing master shutoff or isolation valves that are accessible, working properly, and known to key personnel.

PE-16.enunciado:
a. Authorize and control [Asignación: organization-defined types of system components] entering and exiting the facility; and
b. Maintain records of the system components.

PE-18.enunciado: Position system components within the facility to minimize potential damage from [Asignación: physical and environmental hazards] and to minimize the opportunity for unauthorized access.

PE-19.enunciado: Protect the system from information leakage due to electromagnetic signals emanations.

PE-20.enunciado: Employ [Asignación: asset location technologies] to track and monitor the location and movement of [Asignación: assets] within [Asignación: controlled areas].

PE-22.enunciado: Mark [Asignación: system hardware components] indicating the impact level or classification level of the information permitted to be processed, stored, or transmitted by the hardware component.

PE-23.enunciado:
a. Plan the location or site of the facility where the system resides considering physical and environmental hazards; and
b. For existing facilities, consider the physical and environmental hazards in the organizational risk management strategy.

PE-3(2).enunciado: Perform security checks [Asignación: frequency] at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.

PE-3(3).enunciado: Employ guards to control [Asignación: physical access points] to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

PE-4.enunciado: Control physical access to [Asignación: system distribution and transmission lines] within organizational facilities using [Asignación: security controls].

PE-5.enunciado: Control physical access to output from [Asignación: output devices] to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

PE-6(1).enunciado: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.

PE-6(4).enunciado: Monitor physical access to the system in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at [Asignación: physical spaces].

PE-9.enunciado: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.

PL-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] planning policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the planning policy and the associated planning controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the planning policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current planning:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

PL-7.enunciado:
a. Develop a Concept of Operations (CONOPS) for the system describing how the organization intends to operate the system from the perspective of information security and privacy; and
b. Review and update the CONOPS [Asignación: frequency].

PM-13.enunciado: Establish a security and privacy workforce development and improvement program.

PM-15.titulo: Security and Privacy Groups and Associations
PM-15.enunciado:
Establish and institutionalize contact with selected groups and associations within the security and privacy communities:
  a. To facilitate ongoing security and privacy education and training for organizational personnel;
  b. To maintain currency with recommended security and privacy practices, techniques, and technologies; and
  c. To share current security and privacy information, including threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.

PM-16.enunciado: Implement a threat awareness program that includes a cross-organization information-sharing capability for threat intelligence.

PM-16(1).titulo: Automated Means for Sharing Threat Intelligence
PM-16(1).enunciado: Employ automated mechanisms to maximize the effectiveness of sharing threat intelligence information.

PM-2.enunciado: Appoint a senior agency information security officer with the mission and resources to coordinate, develop, implement, and maintain an organization-wide information security program.

PM-29.enunciado:
a. Appoint a Senior Accountable Official for Risk Management to align organizational information security and privacy management processes with strategic, operational, and budgetary planning processes; and
b. Establish a Risk Executive (function) to view and analyze risk from an organization-wide perspective and ensure management of risk is consistent across the organization.

PS-1.enunciado:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Asignación: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selección (una o más): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] personnel security policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the personnel security policy and the associated personnel security controls;
b. Designate an [Asignación: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the personnel security policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current personnel security:
  1. Policy [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events]; and
  2. Procedures [Asignación: frequency] and following [Asignación: events].

PS-3.enunciado:
a. Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system; and
b. Rescreen individuals in accordance with [Asignación: organization-defined conditions requiring rescreening and, where rescreening is so indicated, the frequency of rescreening].

PS-6.enunciado:
a. Develop and document access agreements for organizational systems;
b. Review and update the access agreements [Asignación: frequency]; and
